prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding status indicators for wait steps (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful; predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) were slightly too low.
Deferring account sign-in significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), and the prediction (+15.0%) was far too high.
Path outcome copy optimization significantly harmed performance (-6.6%), and other copy refinements showed no clear effect; predictions were too high.
Desktop hints, callout overlays, intro redesigns, and layout changes showed no clear effect; predictions (+2.5% to +10.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, wait_info: +14.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -3.4% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.5% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Render Verification Screen: Add a dedicated desktop test screen right before finishing onboarding that confirms the pet renders properly on screen with a quick display test. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open after setup, while finish drop-off remains high at 35.2%.)
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Live Generation Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen with an animated generation preview, dynamic render tips carousel, and explicit wait progress updates. (why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s) and user confusion around pet rendering.)
2: [home, notification] Background Rendering Notification Prompt: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: The waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), indicating users alt-tab away and forget the app.)
3: [adoption, layout] Carousel Friend Selection Layout: Switch the companion pick screen layout to a dynamic carousel featuring animated previews of each pet candidate. (why: The adoption step has a 68.2% conversion rate and median time of 89s, showing friction in selection.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Start Guide Copy Update: Update the home intro text with clear step-by-step instructions on accessing system tray controls and desktop overlay modes. (why: Support received multiple questions regarding pet controls and desktop feature misbehavior after onboarding.)

scores.note: Diagnostic screens previously yielded +6.1% lift, and both support tickets and 35.2% finish drop-off point to this issue.
Status indicators for wait steps delivered strong +14.7% lift, directly addressing extreme wait times (2336s mean).
Addresses extreme mean wait latency where users alt-tab away, though notification prompt adoption varies.
Target step has high drop-off (31.8%), but previous layout tests showed no positive effect (-2.0%).
Low-cost config update matching support tickets, but previous copy optimizations consistently underperformed (-3.4% to -6.6%).
